'''Yumaou Risoath''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was located between the [[Rhoa Yenth]], [[Takal Nax]], [[Rhoa Sammir]] and [[Lhon'kinad]] regions. Its landscape consisted mostly of plateaus and canyons. While the grassy plateaus were sparsely forested, the bottom of the canyons contained lush jungles.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yumaou Risoath was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
